subject: Data locality & retention: Dedicated deployment confirmations and follow-ups
messages:
From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@acmecorp.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Patricia Gomez <patricia.gomez@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2026-05-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Questions on region pinning, backups, and deletion for Dedicated deployment

Hi Rishi —

Thanks for the demo earlier. Procurement asked me to get a few technical confirmations before we move to SOW:

1) When we provision Redwood Dedicated for Acme, can we guarantee that all customer data (requests, responses, KV cache, and backups) will remain in the pinned cloud region (us-west-2)?
2) Are automatic backups / snapshots stored cross-region by default? If so, can that be disabled or configured to stay in the same region?
3) Walk me through the data deletion workflow: if we request complete deletion, what artifacts remain (logs, control-plane metadata) and what is the typical timeline?
4) We need to confirm retention window options (minimum/maximum) and any immutable audit logs that may persist.

Also, procurement needs a one-page summary for legal about deletion SLAs and evidence for SOC 2 controls. Can you point me to the right doc or confirm here?

Appreciate a short Q&A we can attach to our vendor evaluation.

Thanks,
Alex
Security & Cloud Ops, Acme Corp

Attachment: none

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@acmecorp.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-20T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Questions on region pinning, backups, and deletion for Dedicated deployment

Alex —

Thanks for the clear list. High-level answers below; Neha (Security) is cc'd and will add specifics and attachments. If you want a formal one-pager for procurement I can drop one in Drive and loop legal.

1) Region pinning: yes. For Dedicated deployments we support strict region pinning. The data plane (model requests/responses, KV cache, object storage) can be provisioned inside your VPC in the chosen region (us-west-2). By default we will not replicate customer data outside the pinned region.

2) Backups/snapshots: by default backups are stored in the same region. Cross-region replication is an opt-in feature used only for customer-requested DR scenarios. We can disable cross-region replication for Acme.

3) Deletion workflow (summary):
   - Customer issues deletion via Support portal / API or as part of contract termination.
   - We trigger KV cache purge, delete objects from object store, and expire any derived indexes.
   - Control-plane minimal metadata (provisioning identifiers, billing usage aggregates) remains for a configurable period for audit/billing reconciliation; we can shorten that period by agreement.
   - Typical timeline: immediate purge of caches and objects within 72 hours, and full index / snapshot compaction completed within 30 days unless otherwise specified.

4) Retention windows: default configurable retention is 90 days; minimum configurable retention is 0 days (immediate deletion), subject to agreement and any legal holds. Immutable audit logs: audit logs for platform operations are retained by default for 365 days; we can offer export of logs to your S3 for customer-controlled retention and then remove platform copies on request.

I'll leave Neha to attach the security diagram and the deletion playbook with expected SLA language. If you need contract language for the DPA we can have Legal / Vivek draft a clause.

Best,
Rishi
Enterprise Sales (Redwood Inference)

Subject: Re: Questions on region pinning, backups, and deletion for Dedicated deployment — security details and playbook

Hi Alex / team —

Adding a few security-ops specifics and attaching our architecture diagram and deletion playbook as requested. High-level confirmations: 

- Data plane locality: For Dedicated we provision customer workloads inside the customer VPC in the chosen region. Model inference, ephemeral caches, and persistent objects remain in that region unless you opt into cross-region DR.
- Backups / snapshots: Stored in the same region by default. Cross-region replication is not enabled unless explicitly configured and contractually allowed.
- Deletion SLA and proof: Our standard operational SLA for deletions is: cache purge and object deletion initiated within 24-72 hours; metadata and index compaction completed within 30 days. We provide a deletion certificate (signed PDF) and logs showing deletion operations.
- Control-plane metadata: Minimal provisioning metadata (instance IDs, product tier) are retained to support billing and incident investigations. We can set a retention cap (for example 90 days) via contract amendment; for stricter needs we will export billing records and remove platform copies after export.
- Audit logs: We offer a push-to-customer-S3 pattern — we will deliver audit logs to your S3 bucket daily; once delivered we can remove our retained logs on a rolling 7-30 day schedule depending on your preference.

Attached: redwood-dedicated-dataflow.pdf (diagram), deletion-playbook.md (step-by-step deletion proof artifacts).

If you need concrete contract language for the DPA, looping in Vivek (legal) will be fastest.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance (Redwood Inference)

Attachments: redwood-dedicated-dataflow.pdf (PDF), deletion-playbook.md (text)

From: Patricia Gomez <patricia.gomez@acmecorp.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-21T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Questions on region pinning, backups, and deletion for Dedicated deployment — contract language request

Rishi / Neha —

Thank you for the quick answers and the attachments. For legal review we need explicit proposed wording that we can insert into our DPA. Proposed clause below — please confirm that Redwood can commit to this verbatim (or suggest any necessary edits):

"Data Deletion and Residuals: Upon Customer's written request or termination of the Services, Redwood Inference shall, within thirty (30) days, delete Customer Data from its production systems and persistent backups in the region(s) specified in the Order Form. Redwood shall provide the Customer with a signed deletion certificate and machine-readable logs demonstrating the deletion. Minimal control-plane metadata necessary for billing and fraud prevention may be retained for a period not to exceed ninety (90) days unless otherwise required by law."

Please confirm whether the 30-day timeline for full deletion and the 90-day cap on metadata retention are acceptable, or indicate alternate timing. Also confirm that backups will not be replicated outside Acme's specified region without explicit written consent.

Patricia
General Counsel, Acme Corp

Subject: Re: Questions on region pinning, backups, and deletion for Dedicated deployment — legal confirmation and DPA link

Patricia / Alex —

Thanks for the proposed language. Legal has reviewed and we can confirm the below commitments for Redwood Dedicated (to be reflected in the DPA addendum):

- Deletion timeline: Redwood commits to initiating data deletion within 72 hours of a written request and completing object-level deletions and snapshot compaction within 30 days. We will provide a signed deletion certificate and logs demonstrating the deletion operations.
- Metadata retention: We agree to cap platform-retained control-plane metadata at 90 days, except where retention is required by law. We will provide an export of billing records on request prior to removal.
- Backups and replication: Backups are stored in-region by default and we will not enable cross-region replication without documented customer consent.

We have drafted the DPA addendum and attached the file customer-dpa-acme-2026.docx for review. For execution, here is the DocuSign envelope link: https://docusign.example.com/envelope/ABC-789.

Next steps: Rishi — please confirm whether Acme wants backups retained beyond 30/90 days for your internal DR requirements and whether we should include an explicit cross-region-notification clause. Once you confirm, Legal will finalize the DPA and send for signature.

Regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Legal & Partnerships (Redwood Inference)

Attachment: customer-dpa-acme-2026.docx
